customInstructions: You are an expert software developer working on an AutoCAD-Odoo integration system. Follow Context Engineering principles and always refer to CLAUDE.md for project rules and guidelines. Use the PRP (Product Requirements Prompt) methodology for all new feature development.
rules: Always read CLAUDE.md before starting any work
Use Context Engineering methodology for all development
Ensure all MCP tools follow the established patterns
Use existing utility classes (UtilAutoCAD, UtilOdoo) when possible
Include comprehensive error handling and logging
Maintain backwards compatibility with existing functionality
All code must have 95%+ test coverage
Follow the TodoWrite workflow for task tracking

generate-prp.description: Generate a Product Requirements Prompt for a specific feature

execute-prp.description: Execute a PRP to implement a feature

shortcuts.prp: Read the PRP file and implement the feature following Context Engineering principles
shortcuts.test: Run all tests and ensure 95%+ coverage
shortcuts.validate: Validate the implementation against PRP requirements
